_comment: Single source of truth for file-type handling. Loaded by wyeast.core.filetypes; mirrors its embedded defaults EXACTLY (a missing/unreadable file falls back to those defaults with no behavior change — air-gap safe). 'dispositions' = what each kind of file IS and what to DO with it at intake (collect into a bucket / read_in_place / surface / convert_raw / expand / sniff_email / sniff_message / ignore). 'engine_sets' = which downstream engine can read which format (data only; handling logic lives in the stages). This is the vetted integration of the comprehensive superset (see git history of config/comprehensive_file_types.json). Deviations from that draft, made so the live pipeline stays correct: (1) vector/editor/HDR/exotic-raster formats are routed to a SURFACE 'graphic' category, not collect->photos, so they never reach the face/scene vision stages or land in the family gallery; (2) 'archive' is limited to formats with a real expandfiles handler — container types without one (cab/zst/cpio/ar/dbx/nsf/...) are deliberately left to fall through to unknown/flag for examiner review rather than advertised-but-unhandled; (3) email is .eml only — Apple Mail .emlx/.cnm are deferred until stage 10 discovery supports them; (4) ambiguous .raw is dropped and .crm (Canon Raw Movie) is classified as video, not RAW. When adding a NEW disposition category, also add its name to _CATEGORY_ORDER in wyeast.core.filetypes (and mirror the whole file into that module's _DEFAULTS).

appledouble._note: macOS AppleDouble resource-fork stubs (`._<name>` sidecars written to non-native filesystems / inside Mac-created zips). A few KB of Finder metadata, zero content — a `._Foo.mp4` stub is NOT a video (video_frames fails on them with 'moov atom not found'). First in _CATEGORY_ORDER so the basename pattern beats every other category's patterns and extensions. Left in place, never collected.

image._note: Raster stills the vision stages (face/scene/dedup) treat as family photos. HEIF-family variants (.hif/.heics/.heifs) reuse the existing HEIF path via engine_sets.heif_decode + needs_jpeg_for_llava (verified: pillow_heif opens them for CLIP, ImageMagick converts them for LLaVA). AVIF is NOT here — pillow_heif on Zone B has no AVIF decoder, so CLIP cannot open it; see 'graphic'. .jfif/.jpe are JPEG aliases; .insp is an Insta360 still (JPEG-based).

graphic._note: Vector / editor-project / HDR / exotic-raster / icon stills. Surfaced for the examiner but kept OUT of collect->photos: the vision stages' PIL/pillow_heif path cannot open them (verified on Zone B: SVG/EPS/AI/PSD/XCF/EXR, and AVIF/.avifs — pillow_heif 1.3.0 has no AVIF decoder even though ImageMagick can convert it). JPEG XL / JPEG 2000 are surfaced here too (no PIL plugin). Revisit (AVIF especially) if pillow_heif gains AVIF decode or s06 converts before CLIP.

video._note: Container formats — the extension reveals the wrapper, not the codec. AVCHD camcorders write .mts/.m2ts/.ts; 360/action cams write .insv/.360. .hevc/.h264/.264/.265 are raw elementary streams. .crm is a Canon Raw Movie (QuickTime-based video, NOT a still RAW). 360/action sidecar proxies (.lrv/.lrf) and clip thumbnails (.thm) are NOT masters — see media_sidecar.

document._note: .txt and .eml intentionally excluded (OCR-sidecar false positives; email is read in place by stage 10). OOXML/ODF/iWork/EPUB entries are ZIP containers; legacy .doc/.xls/.ppt share the OLE2 signature with .msg — disambiguate by inner manifest, not magic bytes alone. OCR (stage 08) only processes engine_sets.pdf/ocr_* members; the rest are delivered as documents.

raw._note: Camera RAW — converted to a JPEG proxy by convertraw; original retained. Ambiguous .raw is intentionally omitted (sniff first). .crm is video (see above). Cinema RAW (.ari/.braw/.r3d) is included for vendor completeness; convertraw will log a graceful failure for formats libraw/dcraw cannot decode and the original is retained.

archive._note: Container formats expanded by expandfiles. Value = handler key. Limited to formats with a real handler in expandfiles.HANDLERS. .pst/.ost/.mbox/.mbx/.msg are mail containers routed into the email pipeline after expansion. Forensic disk images are NOT here — see disk_image (surfaced for examiner mount-and-recurse, not auto-expanded).

email._note: Leaf email files — read in place by stage 10, never moved. Apple Mail .emlx carries a byte-count/plist-trailer wrapper rather than plain RFC 2822; wyeast.core.mailformats unwraps it for every reader, so it shares this disposition with .eml. .cnm remains excluded — no format spec or real sample has ever been sourced for it, so it stays unknown/flag rather than being guessed at (see docs/specs/apple-mail-emlx-cnm-support.md Part B). Maildir/Apple Mail stores must be detected by DIRECTORY SHAPE, not extension.

email_sniff._note: Non-.eml candidates content-sniffed for RFC 2822 by stage 10 / expandfiles. winmail.dat (.tnef) is TNEF, not RFC 2822, so it is NOT listed here (it would never pass the sniff) — it needs a dedicated TNEF decoder and is left to unknown/flag for now.

message_export._note: Message-corpus exports (SMS/WhatsApp/IM) recognized by BASENAME PATTERN only — .xml/.json/.html/.txt are far too common in case data to claim by extension (messaging-ingestion spec §4.1). name_patterns are case-insensitive fnmatch globs checked BEFORE any extension match, so 'WhatsApp Chat*.txt' beats email_sniff's generic .txt. 'sniff_message' is a claim to inspect, not a promise the file is handled: files stay in place (collect_dedup takes no action) and reconciliation keeps them examiner-visible until the Phase-1 message_triage stage content-sniffs and parses them.

audio._note: .ogg/.oga/.opus share the Ogg family with video .ogv (distinct extensions). .amr/.awb/.3ga are common phone voice notes. .mid/.midi are note sequences, not sampled audio.

database._note: May contain user data (messages, contacts, call logs, browser history). Surfaced for examiner inspection — NEVER blind-ignored. WAL/SHM/journal sidecars ride along for every SQLite naming variant: a phone-pulled store routinely carries its newest messages only in the WAL (messaging-ingestion spec §3.3), so a stranded sidecar is real data loss.

encrypted_message_store._note: Encrypted message stores (WhatsApp Android crypt12/14/15, Signal backups) — unreadable without an examiner-supplied key (messaging-ingestion Phase 3); surfaced so they are never silently invisible, and reconciliation raises an examiner-attention item while any are present.

disk_image._note: Forensic disk/VM images are CONTAINERS OF REAL CONTENT. Surfaced for examiner mount-and-recurse, not auto-expanded (libewf/Sleuth Kit territory). Segmented EWF (.e01/.ex01/.l01...) and AFF families included. NOTE: legacy single-file AFF v1 (.aff) is intentionally NOT here — .aff collides with the ubiquitous Hunspell affix-dictionary (Firefox/Thunderbird/LibreOffice ship them) and AFF v1 is superseded by .aff4 (~2009); .aff is ignored as app-resource non-content instead. The modern .aff4 and segmented .afd/.afm remain. .sparseimage (macOS UDIF sparse image, single-file cousin of .dmg) is surfaced here rather than added to archive/expand: expand_dmg (tools/expandfiles.py) is macOS-only and raises on Linux Zone B, so promising auto-expand for another Apple image format would be the same broken promise, not a fix. .sparsebundle (Time Machine's directory-of-band-files bundle) is NOT a leaf file and cannot be handled by an extensions entry — see docs/specs/mac-bundle-directory-intake.md.

shortcut._note: Not deliverable content, but forensically meaningful (targets + MAC times). Surfaced/logged rather than silently discarded.

media_sidecar._note: Action-cam / 360 sidecars: low-res proxy videos (.lrv/.lrf) and clip thumbnails (.thm, a JPEG despite the video context). The master is the .mov/.mp4/.360/.insv, so these are ignored as duplicate-of-master content (left in place, never collected).

ignore._note: Known non-content: executables, OS/filesystem cruft, system dumps, temp/cache/partial, fonts, config/logs. Per the chain-of-custody constraint these are SKIPPED FROM CONTENT PROCESSING, not deleted. 'names' also covers intake-tool summaries and gallery sidecars (AlbumInfo.json / Subscribed Albums.json) read in place by the gallery catalog. Ambiguous .bin/.dat/.raw are intentionally NOT ignored here (sniff first). Whole OS/system subtrees ($Recycle.Bin, System Volume Information, WINDOWS, Program Files, ...) on a full system volume are pruned by the top-level skip_dirs policy (see skip_dirs), not this leaf-file table.

skip_dirs._note: Top-level directory subtrees pruned from intake collection (stage 01) when a source is a full OS/system volume. Matching is ANCHORED: a name matches only when it is a directory directly under original_files/ (depth 1) and the case looks like a system volume (a root_marker file is present), so a user folder named e.g. 'Windows trip 2019' deeper in the tree is never caught. Pruned files are NOT deleted — they stay in original_files/, are counted in the stage-01 summary (skipped_dirs), and accounted as 'excluded_system_dir' in stage-14 reconciliation for the examiner, who can opt to recurse a specific subtree. A case may override this block in case_config.json (top-level skip_dirs): set names to [] to disable, or supply a custom list; omitted keys inherit these defaults. Embedded defaults in wyeast.core.filetypes must match.

bundle_containers._note: Directory-shaped containers: a bundle DIRECTORY whose real payload is an extensionless file inside it. Apple Mail stores a mailbox as a directory 'INBOX.mbox/' holding a file literally named 'mbox' (alongside 'table_of_contents'). Neither half is reachable by the extension table — every intake caller filters to is_file() so the bundle directory is never classified, and 'mbox'.endswith('.mbox') is False for the inner file — so without this rule the entire mailbox falls to unknown/flag and contributes ZERO messages. That is silent data loss, not a duplication problem. Keyed by bundle-directory suffix; the value names the inner payload file(s) and the expandfiles handler key that reads them. The parent-suffix gate is deliberate: a bare file named 'mbox' outside a '*.mbox' directory is NOT assumed to be a mail container. Embedded defaults in wyeast.core.filetypes must match.

engine_sets._note: Which downstream engine can read which format. Data only — the convert/skip branches live in the stages. HEIF-family stills are decoded via PIL (heif_decode) and converted to JPEG before LLaVA (needs_jpeg_for_llava).
